say:4:1820622001:0.text: Mama! It's those guys from earlier! They brought me home!
say:4:1820622001:0.source_cn: 妈妈！是，刚刚的人！带皮普回家的人！

say:5:1820622002:0.text: What? You mean they were human just moments earlier?

say:6:1820622003:0.text: Did Baba Muriel just turn you into animals too? That was fast.
say:6:1820622003:0.source_cn: 穆婆婆，让你们也变成了动物？这么快？

say:7:1820622004:0.text: So Baba Muriel really was behind this... What on earth did she do to you?!
say:7:1820622004:0.source_cn: 你们果然是被穆婆婆变成这样的。她对你们做了什么？！

choice_prompt:8:1820622004.text: So Baba Muriel really was behind this... What on earth did she do to you?!
choice_prompt:8:1820622004.source_cn: 你们果然是被穆婆婆变成这样的。她对你们做了什么？！

say:9:1820622005:0.text: Baba Muriel helped us. She turned us into animals. Like me.
say:9:1820622005:0.source_cn: 穆婆婆帮助我们，变成动物。像我这样。

say:10:1820622006:0.text: Long ago... I was a Graveborn. I lived in Twilight Village. But... I don't remember much anymore...
say:10:1820622006:0.source_cn: 很久以前，是亡灵，夕染村的亡灵。但是，记忆变模糊了……

say:11:1820622007:0.text: Those in the city... needed new limbs and bones. Not enough replacements.
say:11:1820622007:0.source_cn: 城里人说要换手臂，换腿，换肋骨。可是没有那些东西。

say:13:1820622009:0.text: You bring Thane up to speed on the Graveborn's practice of replacing their body parts to slow the erosion of their memories and sanity.
say:13:1820622009:0.source_cn: 你为瑟恩简单讲述了亡灵需要更换肢体，防止记忆和意识磨损...
say:13:1820622009:0.male: You bring Thane up to speed on the Graveborn's practice of replacing their body parts to slow the erosion of their memories and sanity.
say:13:1820622009:0.female: You bring Thane up to speed on the Graveborn's practice of replacing their body parts to slow the erosion of their memories and sanity.

say:14:1820622010:1.text: After a long, silent pause, Thane draws a long, deep breath.
say:14:1820622010:1.source_cn: 瑟恩沉默着，很久很久才深深地、缓慢地吸了一口气。
say:14:1820622010:1.male: After a long, silent pause, Thane draws a long, deep breath.
say:14:1820622010:1.female: After a long, silent pause, Thane draws a long, deep breath.

say:15:1820622011:0.text: Now I know why heavy weapons are so effective against Bantus soldiers. Even in armor, their fragile bodies can barely withstand such blows.
say:15:1820622011:0.source_cn: 难怪重型武器能够轻易击杀班题斯士兵。他们的身体太过脆弱...

say:16:1820622012:0.text: So, you all were once villagers of Twilight Village, and Baba Muriel turned you into animals because there were no replacement body parts available. Is that right?
say:16:1820622012:0.source_cn: 所以，你们曾经是夕染村的村民。但因为没有可以用于更换的...

say:18:1820622014:0.text: My body rotted away; my soul remained. The cat became my new body.
say:18:1820622014:0.source_cn: 原本的身体腐烂了，灵魂，还在。动物是新的身体。

choice_prompt:19:1820622014.text: My body rotted away; my soul remained. The cat became my new body.
choice_prompt:19:1820622014.source_cn: 原本的身体腐烂了，灵魂，还在。动物是新的身体。

say:20:1820622015:0.text: Soul transfer... I've heard of that before.
say:20:1820622015:0.source_cn: 灵魂转移……好像，是这个词。

say:21:1820622016:0.text: Baba Muriel... didn't want us to suffer. As animals, we think less... and forget many things.
say:21:1820622016:0.source_cn: 穆婆婆，不希望我们痛苦。动物的身体，思考得很少，忘记了很多。

say:22:1820622017:0.text: Then maybe you've forgotten who she really is. She's nowhere near as kind as you make her out to be.
say:22:1820622017:0.source_cn: 或许你也忘记了她的为人。她远没有你说的那么友善。

say:23:1820622018:0.text: You only know her now. She wasn't like this before.
say:23:1820622018:0.source_cn: 你只看到现在。以前，她不是这样。

say:24:1820622019:0.text: Back then... she was just a caregiver. She didn't know magic. She learned it to help us.
say:24:1820622019:0.source_cn: 很久以前，她不会魔法，只会照顾孩子。为了我们，她才学习魔法。

say:25:1820622020:0.text: Her personality changed. After she replaced many parts of her body.
say:25:1820622020:0.source_cn: 她换过身体。手臂、腿……很多。性格就变了。

choice_prompt:26:1820622020.text: Her personality changed. After she replaced many parts of her body.
choice_prompt:26:1820622020.source_cn: 她换过身体。手臂、腿……很多。性格就变了。

say:27:1820622021:0.text: I'm not sure what that means. Maybe.
say:27:1820622021:0.source_cn: 不知道那个词的意思。也许是吧。

say:28:1820622022:1.text: Baba's a good person! She always gives me head scratches! *Purr*
say:28:1820622022:1.source_cn: 穆婆婆是好人！经常帮皮普挠头！呼噜噜~

say:29:1820622023:0.text: ... He's behaving just like a cat now.
say:29:1820622023:0.source_cn: ……皮普的行为已经和动物没什么区别了。

say:30:1820622024:0.text: We all act like animals... to some extent. Pipp's smaller, so it's more obvious.
say:30:1820622024:0.source_cn: 动物行为，大家都有。只不过，皮普体型小，更严重。

say:31:1820622025:0.text: But he's happy now. No more worries. That's good.
say:31:1820622025:0.source_cn: 但是，他很开心，没有忧愁。足够了。

choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 你是说她出现了记忆混淆？

choice:19:0:1.text: Sounds like soul transfer to me.
choice:19:0:1.male: Sounds like soul transfer to me.
choice:19:0:1.female: Sounds like soul transfer to me.
